context: Code: packages/service/src/ship_no_ship_service/doctor.py (Mach-O dependency closure) and macho.py. Evidence: plan evidence dir review-r2/adjudication.md, fix-verification round 4.
description: doctor resolves @rpath separately for each loading chain. On a toolchain tree built so many libraries load each other through many rpaths, the number of chains grows exponentially, and the recursive walk can also hit Python's recursion limit. Result: doctor hangs or crashes rather than passing, so it is not a bypass. Planting such a tree needs write access to the root-owned toolchain. Found by the independent fix review of the doctor PR, deferred as Low.
